subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin introduce an opt-in action for groups absent from `channels.whatsapp.groups`, and should the first version auto-leave, notify the owner, or do both?
rationale: Leaving a WhatsApp group is destructive and visible to group members, while an event or tool creates a persistent authorization and privacy contract; existing sender authorization cannot safely determine that group-membership boundary.

options.title: Narrow opt-in group action
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned `unknownGroupAction` based only on group admission, defaulting to current drop behavior and supporting an explicitly configured leave or owner notification.

options.title: Pairing design first
options.body: Fold the behavior into the cross-channel pairing design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489 before adding WhatsApp-specific configuration.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Retain the current dropped-message warning and defer all membership automation until a stronger product need is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Narrow opt-in group action
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned `unknownGroupAction` based only on group admission, defaulting to current drop behavior and supporting an explicitly configured leave or owner notification.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the previous maintainer-side review for this exact decision boundary and have adjacent WhatsApp runtime/documentation history.
